::: {#def-prediction}
#### Prediction (predicted value)

A **prediction** (or **predicted value**) $\fitted(x)$
of an outcome $Y$ with covariate value $X = x$
is a number computed from $x$ and from data $(\predvar_1, \outvar_1), \ldots, (\predvar_n, \outvar_n)$
by a rule $g$, and used as a guess of $Y$:

$$\fitted(x) \eqdef g\paren{x; (\predvar_1, \outvar_1), \ldots, (\predvar_n, \outvar_n)}.$$
:::
